name: codex-session-hub
description: Local-first Codex multi-session task memory and Obsidian knowledge extraction.

interface.shortDescription: Sync Codex task sessions, handoffs, open questions, and Obsidian knowledge cards.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex plugin for multi-conversation workflows. It stores task summaries, decisions, open questions, handoffs, and durable knowledge cards as Markdown so other Codex conversations can recover context without reading full chat transcripts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use session-hub to sync this Codex task, list active sessions, or extract durable knowledge to Obsidian.
